en: Mixed fresh berries (strawberries and blueberries) 80 g
Place the Greek yogurt in a serving bowl.
Arrange the mixed berries on top.
Drizzle the honey over the yogurt and berries.
Sprinkle with chia seeds and granola if desired and serve immediately.
Mix the flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Add the egg, milk and vanilla, whisk until the batter is smooth with no lumps.
Pour a tablespoon of batter into a hot non-stick pan for each pancake.
Cook 2-3 minutes on each side until bubbles appear and it turns golden, serve with the honey.
Whey protein powder 20 g (or an extra egg white as a substitute)
Cook the oats with the milk in a small pot over medium heat for 5-6 minutes, stirring, until the texture thickens.
Remove from heat, let it cool slightly (one minute).
Add the protein powder and stir well until fully dissolved with no lumps.
Sprinkle with cinnamon, arrange the banana slices on top and serve warm.
A few drops of olive oil
Whisk the egg whites with salt and black pepper in a bowl.
Heat a few drops of oil in a pan, add the onion and bell pepper, cook 3 minutes.
Add the spinach, cook one minute until wilted.
Pour the egg whites over the vegetables, cook while stirring for 3-4 minutes until set, serve hot.
Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.
Arrange the banana slices on top.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and a drizzle of honey if desired and serve immediately.
Place the frozen berries, banana and yogurt in a blender.
Blend until the texture is thick and smooth (add a little water if needed to help blend).
Arrange the granola and chia seeds on top if desired and serve immediately.
Fresh or canned pineapple in natural juice, cut into pieces, 80 g
Place the cottage cheese in a serving bowl.
Arrange the pineapple pieces on top.
Garnish with mint leaves if desired.
Mashed avocado, half an avocado (75 g)
Toast the bread slice until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with salt and black pepper.
Cook the egg in your preferred method, place it on top of the avocado, sprinkle with chili flakes if desired and serve immediately.
Place all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend until the texture is smooth and combined.
Muesli (rolled oats, dried fruit and nuts) 50 g
Place the muesli in a serving bowl.
Let it sit for 5 minutes to soften slightly.
Mixed lettuce and arugula 100 g total
1 tsp olive oil and balsamic vinegar 1 tsp
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until fully cooked, let it rest then slice.
Arrange the lettuce, arugula, tomato and cucumber in a serving bowl.
Add the sliced chicken over the salad, drizzle with oil and vinegar and serve immediately.
Salt, black pepper and fresh dill (optional)
Season the salmon fillet with salt, black pepper, lemon juice and oil.
Bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until cooked.
Steam the broccoli for 5-6 minutes until tender but still slightly crisp.
Serve the salmon over the brown rice with the broccoli, garnish with fresh dill if desired.
1 tsp olive oil and lemon juice
Place the cooked quinoa in the centre of the serving plate.
Arrange the tomato and cucumber around the plate.
Drizzle with oil and lemon juice, sprinkle with parsley over everything and serve.
Whole-wheat tortilla wrap, 1 large piece (70 g)
Lay the tortilla on the work surface.
Spread with the mustard or mayonnaise.
Arrange the lettuce, tomato, turkey and cucumber in the centre, sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Roll it tightly, cut in half and serve.
Canned tuna in water, drained, 120 g
1 tsp olive oil and lemon juice
Drain the tuna well and flake it with a fork.
Mix it with the lettuce, tomato, cucumber and corn in a bowl.
Drizzle with the oil and lemon juice.
Lemon juice 1 tbsp and 1 tsp olive oil
Season the shrimp with the garlic, lemon juice and oil.
Bake at 220°C for 8-10 minutes until fully cooked.
Mix the quinoa with the cherry tomatoes.
Serve the shrimp over the quinoa, garnish with parsley and serve hot.
Mixed stir-fry vegetables (broccoli, carrot, bell pepper) 150 g
1 crushed garlic clove and grated ginger 1 tsp
A few drops of sesame oil
Brown the garlic and ginger in a dry pan for one minute.
Add the chicken, cook 4-5 minutes until golden.
Add the vegetables, cook 5-6 minutes until cooked but still slightly crisp.
Add the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss well and serve hot.

name.en: Lentil Soup with Whole Grain Bread

en: Brown the onion, carrot and garlic in a dry pot for 4 minutes.
Add the lentils, stock and cumin.
Cover and simmer 20-25 minutes until the lentils are fully softened.
Partially blend the soup if desired for a smoother texture, serve hot with the bread.
Mixed vegetables (zucchini, bell pepper, onion) 150 g
Season the fish fillet and vegetables with salt, black pepper, thyme and lemon juice.
Arrange on a lined baking tray, drizzle oil over everything.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until the fish is cooked and the vegetables are tender.

name.en: Brown Rice Bowl with Grilled Chicken and Vegetables

en: Light soy sauce or lemon dressing 1 tbsp
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until fully cooked, let it rest then slice.
Arrange the rice in a serving bowl, place the chicken and vegetables on top, drizzle with the dressing and serve.
White fish fillet (tilapia or cod) 180 g
A pinch of paprika, salt and black pepper
Season the fish fillet with salt, black pepper and paprika.
Mix the garlic, lemon juice and oil, brush over the fish.
Arrange on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until cooked, garnish with parsley and serve hot.
Carrot and celery, diced, 80 g total
Brown the onion, carrot and celery in a dry pot for 4-5 minutes.
Add the chicken, cook 3 minutes until golden.
Add the stock, cover and simmer 15-18 minutes until the chicken and vegetables are fully cooked.
Season with salt and black pepper, garnish with parsley and serve hot.
Diced bell pepper and chopped onion
A few drops of olive oil
Whisk the eggs and egg white with salt and black pepper.
Heat a few drops of oil in a pan, add the onion and bell pepper, cook 3 minutes until softened.
Add the spinach, cook until wilted.
Pour the eggs over the vegetables, cook 3-4 minutes until partially set, sprinkle with the cheese, fold the omelet in half and serve.
Paprika and garlic powder, a pinch each
Season the chicken thighs with the oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and black pepper.
Arrange on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200°C for 25-30 minutes until fully cooked and golden.
1 tsp olive oil and a pinch of dried oregano
Mix the cucumber, tomato and red onion in a bowl.
Drizzle with the oil and oregano.
Crumble the feta over the salad and serve immediately.

name.en: Grilled Turkey Breast with Steamed Vegetables

en: Mixed steamed vegetables (carrot, zucchini, green beans) 150 g
Season the turkey breast with salt, black pepper and thyme.
Bake at 200°C for 20-22 minutes until fully cooked.
Steam the vegetables for 8-10 minutes until tender.
Serve the turkey with the vegetables, drizzle with oil and lemon juice over both.
Salt, black pepper and fresh dill
Season the salmon fillet with salt, black pepper and lemon juice.
Arrange with the asparagus on a lined baking tray, drizzle oil over both.
Bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until the salmon is cooked and the asparagus is tender.
Garnish with fresh dill and serve hot.

name.en: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Ground Turkey

en: Large bell peppers, 2 pieces, halved and seeded
Brown the onion and ground turkey in a dry pan for 5-6 minutes until golden.
Mix with the rice, tomato, cumin, salt and black pepper.
Stuff the pepper halves with the mixture.
Arrange on a baking tray, bake at 200°C for 25-30 minutes until the peppers are tender, serve hot.
1 tsp olive oil and lemon juice
Season the shrimp with the garlic, lemon juice and oil.
Bake at 220°C for 8-10 minutes until fully cooked.
Serve over the salad greens and cherry tomatoes.

name.en: Baked Chicken Breast with Sweet Potato

en: A pinch of paprika, salt and black pepper
Season the chicken breast and sweet potato cubes with the oil, paprika, salt and black pepper.
Arrange on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200°C for 20-22 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sweet potato is tender.
Arrange the cucumber slices on a serving plate.
Place the cottage cheese on top.
Sprinkle with black pepper and lemon juice.
Garnish with dill if desired and serve immediately.
A few drops of olive oil (optional)
Place the eggs in a pot with water covering them, bring to a boil then cook 8-10 minutes depending on desired doneness.
Drain the eggs and cover with cold water to cool, then peel.
Cut the eggs in half and arrange on a serving plate.
Sprinkle with thyme, salt, black pepper and a few drops of oil if desired and serve.
Cut all the fruits as described.
Mix them in a serving bowl.
Sprinkle with lemon juice to prevent the apple from browning.
Garnish with mint leaves if desired and serve chilled.
Crispy puffed rice cakes, 2 pieces (20 g)
Mash the avocado with salt and black pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado over the rice cakes.
Arrange the diced tomato on top.
Sprinkle with chili flakes if desired and serve immediately.
Paprika and ground cumin, a pinch each
Pat the chickpeas dry well with a paper towel.
Mix with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt.
Spread on a lined tray in a single layer.
Roast in the oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp, let cool slightly and serve.
Cut the apple into medium-thick slices.
Place the peanut butter on the side for dipping.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve immediately.
Lay each turkey slice on a flat surface.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese, sprinkle with black pepper.
Place a cucumber stick at the edge and roll the slice tightly around it.
Serve cold, cut in half if desired.
Frozen edamame in pods 150 g (or shelled 100 g)
Boil water in a medium pot.
Add the edamame, cook 4-5 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle with sea salt and serve warm or chilled.
Mixed unsalted nuts (almonds, walnuts, cashews) 25 g
Combine the nuts with the dried fruit in a small bowl.
A splash of water or milk if needed
Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until a cohesive dough forms (add a little water or milk if it's too dry).
Shape into small balls with your hands.
Mix the chia seeds with the milk, honey and vanilla in a bowl.
Stir well until the chia seeds are evenly distributed.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (overnight is best) until the texture thickens.
Stir again before serving, garnish with fresh berries if desired and serve cold.
Peel the bananas and slice them, freeze overnight at least.
Place the frozen banana slices in a blender.
Add the milk, vanilla and cinnamon if desired, blend until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately with a soft-serve texture, or freeze for another hour for a firmer texture.
Core the apple while keeping its outer shape intact.
Fill the cavity with the cinnamon, honey and walnuts if desired.
Place it in a small oven-safe dish.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until softened, serve warm.
Place the yogurt in a serving bowl.
Drizzle with honey over everything and serve immediately.
Mash the banana in a bowl until smooth.
Add the oats, cinnamon and walnuts if desired, mix well.
Shape the mixture into small flattened balls, arrange on a lined tray.
Bake at 180°C for 15-18 minutes until golden, let cool before serving.
Mix the yogurt with the pureed berries and honey in a bowl.
Stir well until the mixture is combined.
Freeze for at least 4 hours until fully set, unmold and serve.
Dark chocolate (70% or higher), melted, 20 g
Wash and dry the strawberries well, keeping the stems.
Melt the chocolate using a double boiler or in short microwave bursts.
Dip each strawberry halfway into the chocolate.
Arrange on parchment paper, chill in the fridge for 15 minutes until the chocolate sets and serve.
Ground cinnamon for garnish, a pinch
Place the rice and milk in a small pot over medium heat.
Cook 10-12 minutes while stirring constantly until the texture becomes creamy.
Remove from heat, add the honey and vanilla and stir.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve warm or cold.

name.en: Baked Pear with Honey and Walnuts

en: Medium pear, halved and cored, 180 g
Place the pear halves cut-side up in a small baking dish.
Sprinkle with the walnuts and cinnamon.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until soft, serve warm.
Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until the texture is completely smooth with no lumps.
Chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
